name: Music engine
description: Composes a music bed in code: a seed picks one melody, and each mood (upbeat, chill, tense, epic, funny, inspiring) plays it with its own chords, instruments and groove. Run: python music_engine.py --mood upbeat --seconds 90 --seed 7 --out music.wav (--bpm to change the tempo, --list for moods).
whenToUse: Default for music: compose the score with one seed for the whole video and switch moods between sections so it stays one theme. Place the WAV on the Music track with duck on.

mood.description: upbeat, chill, tense, epic, funny, inspiring

seed.description: Picks the melody; keep it the same across a video
